title: Cantilever beam
sentence: A steel cantilever under a tip load — the first model to build, and the standard check against beam theory.

expected.reference: Euler–Bernoulli + Timoshenko δ = PL³/3EI + PL/κGA = 0.1919619 mm

theory: A tip-loaded cantilever deflects $\delta_b = \dfrac{PL^3}{3EI}$, with $I = \dfrac{bh^3}{12}$ for a rectangular section. Here $L = 1\,\mathrm{m}$, $P = 1\,\mathrm{kN}$, $E = 210\,\mathrm{GPa}$ and $b = h = 100\,\mathrm{mm}$, so bending gives $0.1905\,\mathrm{mm}$. Benchmark B1 includes the Timoshenko shear term $\delta_s = \dfrac{PL}{\kappa GA}$ and uses $\delta_b + \delta_s = 0.1919619\,\mathrm{mm}$ as the independent reference.
